analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 211,750) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 199,050 / KRW 214,788 / KRW 240,316): Trading near the middle band, below short-term EMAs, above mid-term EMAs.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (KRW 255,274 / KRW 236,600): Below long-term EMAs, indicating a weak phase.
· 52-week position (41.9%) + Current price level is elevated from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.9 → 45.1): Exiting oversold territory and entering neutral zone, with weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-513.1014 → -211.0502): Improving within negative territory, no confirmation of bearish reversal yet.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Upper 240,650 / Middle 214,788 / Lower 188,925): Sideways movement around the middle band, with band width expanding to 24.08%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 204,500): Based on pivot (KRW 213,317) and SMA5 (KRW 199,050).
· Swing resistance (KRW 223,000): Below Bollinger Band upper (KRW 240,650) and SMA20 (KRW 214,788).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high KRW 214,000, 5-day low KRW 179,200; 20-day high KRW 249,000, 20-day low KRW 179,200): 5-day low > 20-day low * 1.005, 5-day high < 20-day high * 0.995 -> sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.35): Below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI holding neutral, MACD showing improvement, ADX entering early trend formation. Consider buying upon confirmation of KRW 204,500 support, strengthen buy position upon breaking KRW 223,000 resistance.
